description: Three-panel summary: catalytic-loop specificity signature, DFG-in/out geometry of PDB 6SEQ against reference structures, and vertebrate ortholog conservation of LMTK3 catalytic motifs
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict

# ---------------- recompute inputs ----------------
# (1) human scorecard
accs={"LMTK3":"Q96Q04","LMTK2":"Q8IWU2","LMTK1/AATK":"Q6ZMQ8","SRC":"P12931","ABL1":"P00519",
      "INSR":"P06213","EGFR":"P00533","FGFR1":"P11362","PKACA":"P17612","CDK2":"P24941",
      "ERK2":"P28482","CAMK2A":"Q9UQM7","ERBB3 (pseudo)":"P21860","STRADA (pseudo)":"Q7RTN6"}
dom={"LMTK3":(133,411),"LMTK2":(137,407),"LMTK1/AATK":(125,395),"SRC":(270,523),"ABL1":(242,493),
     "INSR":(1023,1298),"EGFR":(712,979),"FGFR1":(478,767),"PKACA":(44,298),"CDK2":(4,286),
     "ERK2":(25,313),"CAMK2A":(13,271),"ERBB3 (pseudo)":(709,966),"STRADA (pseudo)":(59,315)}
seq={k:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,a in accs.items()}
def cl_of(kd):
    for m in re.finditer(r"[HY].D[LIVMFY]", kd):
        p=m.start()
        if 0.35*len(kd)<p<0.80*len(kd) and p+8<=len(kd) and kd[p+7]=='N': return kd[p:p+8]
    return None
TKC,STKC="HRDLAARN","HRDLKPEN"
spec=[]
for k in accs:
    kd=seq[k][dom[k][0]-1:dom[k][1]]; cl=cl_of(kd)
    spec.append(dict(kinase=k, cat_loop=cl or "degraded",
                     tk=sum(1 for a,b in zip(cl,TKC) if a==b) if cl else 0,
                     stk=sum(1 for a,b in zip(cl,STKC) if a==b) if cl else 0))
S=pd.DataFrame(spec)

# (2) DFG geometry
CACHE={}
def load(p):
    if p not in CACHE:
        t=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",timeout=120).text
        A=defaultdict(dict)
        for l in t.split("\n"):
            if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[16] in (" ","A"):
                A[(l[21],int(l[22:26]))][l[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        CACHE[p]=A
    return CACHE[p]
def dun(p,c,k3,e,f):
    A=load(p); g=lambda r,a: A.get((c,r),{}).get(a)
    z=g(f,'CZ')
    d1=float(np.linalg.norm(g(e+4,'CA')-z)); d2=float(np.linalg.norm(g(k3,'CA')-z))
    nz=g(k3,'NZ'); sb=min(float(np.linalg.norm(g(e,a)-nz)) for a in ('OE1','OE2'))
    return d1,d2,sb
ST=[("LMTK3 6SEQ","6SEQ","A",193,210,314,"tab:red"),
    ("PKA 1ATP (active)","1ATP","E",72,91,185,"tab:green"),
    ("SRC 1Y57 (active)","1Y57","A",295,310,405,"tab:green"),
    ("INSR 1IR3 (active)","1IR3","A",1030,1047,1151,"tab:green"),
    ("SRC 2SRC (aC-out)","2SRC","A",295,310,405,"tab:orange"),
    ("SRC 1FMK (autoinhib)","1FMK","A",295,310,405,"tab:orange"),
    ("ABL1 1IEP (DFG-out)","1IEP","A",271,286,382,"tab:purple"),
    ("ABL1 1OPJ (DFG-out)","1OPJ","A",271,286,382,"tab:purple")]
G=[]
for lbl,p,c,k3,e,f,col in ST:
    try: d1,d2,sb=dun(p,c,k3,e,f); G.append(dict(label=lbl,D1=d1,D2=d2,sb=sb,color=col))
    except Exception as ex: print("skip",p,ex)
G=pd.DataFrame(G); print(G.round(2).to_string(index=False))

# (3) ortholog motif counts
js=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":"(gene:LMTK3) AND (taxonomy_id:7742)",
    "fields":"accession,organism_name,sequence","format":"json","size":500},timeout=120).json()["results"]
rows=[]
for e in js:
    s=e["sequence"]["value"]
    if len(s)<800: continue
    cl=None
    for m in re.finditer(r"[HY].D[LIVMFY]", s):
        p=m.start()
        if p+8<=len(s) and s[p+7]=='N': cl=(s[p:p+8],p); break
    if not cl: continue
    mg=re.search(r"D[FLWYIMHA]G", s[cl[1]+12:cl[1]+50])
    rows.append(dict(org=e["organism"]["scientificName"], cl=cl[0], mg=mg.group() if mg else "NA"))
O=pd.DataFrame(rows).drop_duplicates(subset=["org","cl","mg"])
print("\northologs n=%d  species=%d"%(len(O),O.org.nunique()))
print(O.cl.value_counts().head(8)); print(O.mg.value_counts().head(5))

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15.5,5.4))

ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,1)
y=np.arange(len(S))[::-1]
ax.barh(y+0.18, S.tk, height=0.36, color="#c44e52", label="match to HRDLAARN (Tyr-kinase)")
ax.barh(y-0.18, S.stk, height=0.36, color="#4c72b0", label="match to HRDLKPEN (Ser/Thr-kinase)")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{k}  {c}" for k,c in zip(S.kinase,S.cat_loop)], fontsize=8.5)
for lab in ax.get_yticklabels():
    if lab.get_text().startswith("LMTK"): lab.set_color("#c44e52"); lab.set_fontweight("bold")
ax.set_xlabel("identities out of 8 catalytic-loop positions"); ax.set_xlim(0,8.6)
ax.set_title("A  Catalytic-loop signature\nall three LMTKs carry HSDLALRN", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc="lower right"); ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,2)
for _,r in G.iterrows():
    ax.scatter(r.D1,r.D2,s=120 if "LMTK3" in r.label else 70,c=r.color,
               edgecolor="k",zorder=3,marker="D" if "LMTK3" in r.label else "o")
    ax.annotate(r.label,(r.D1,r.D2),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(7,4),fontsize=7.5)
ax.axvline(11,ls="--",c="grey"); ax.axhline(11,ls="--",c="grey")
ax.text(4.2,17.5,"DFG-in\n(catalytically\ncompetent pose)",fontsize=8,color="tab:green")
ax.text(12.2,6.0,"DFG-out\n(inactive pose)",fontsize=8,color="tab:purple")
ax.set_xlabel(r"D1: $\alpha$C-Glu+4 C$\alpha$ to DFG-Phe/Tyr C$\zeta$ ($\AA$)")
ax.set_ylabel(r"D2: $\beta$3-Lys C$\alpha$ to DFG-Phe/Tyr C$\zeta$ ($\AA$)")
ax.set_title("B  Conformation of the crystallised LMTK3 kinase domain\nModi and Dunbrack spatial criterion", fontsize=10)
ax.grid(alpha=.3)

ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,3)
cc=O.cl.value_counts(); mc=O.mg.value_counts()
labels=list(cc.index[:4])+list(mc.index[:3])
vals=list(cc.values[:4])+list(mc.values[:3])
cols=["#c44e52"]*min(4,len(cc))+["#55a868"]*min(3,len(mc))
ax.bar(range(len(vals)),vals,color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(labels))); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=9)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+1,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("number of vertebrate LMTK3 entries")
ax.set_title("C  Conservation across %d vertebrate LMTK3 entries\ncatalytic loop (red) and Mg-binding motif (green)"%len(O), fontsize=10)
ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
